Step:  
08-25-1225 is August 25, 1225.  
17 weeks and 5 days = 17×7 + 5 = 124 days.  
Subtract 124 days from August 25, 1225.  

August 25 minus 124 days:  
Go back 31 days to July 25 (31 days in July).  
124 − 31 = 93 days left.  
Go back 30 days to June 25 (30 days in June).  
93 − 30 = 63 days left.  
Go back 31 days to May 25 (31 days in May).  
63 − 31 = 32 days left.  
Go back 30 days to April 25 (30 days in April).  
32 − 30 = 2 days left.  
April 25 minus 2 days = April 23, 1225.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1225-04-23
